newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-MICHAEL JOHNSON WINS JESSE OWENS TROPHY AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MICHAEL JOHNSON WINS JESSE OWENS TROPHY AGAIN.

text.p: Michael Johnson, winner of Olympic gold medals in the 200 and 400 meters in Atlanta, has won the Jesse Owens International Trophy for the second consecutive year.
The award, according to a news release, is presented annually to the athlete who best personifies excellence in athletic performance and promotes cooperation and understanding throughout the world.
Johnson who set the world record for 200 meters at 19.32 seconds and the Olympic record for 400 meters at 43.49, is the first athlete to win the Owens trophy twice.
Swimmer Michelle Smith of Ireland was second in the voting, and weightlifter Naim Suleymanoglu of Turkey was third.
